versions.changelog:
- Added _meta.json file to the project.
- Updated SKILL.md to version 0.1.1, specifying required binaries (node, npx) in metadata.
- Removed skill-card.md from the repository.

Initial release of Claude-Flow — a multi-agent orchestration platform for Claude Code.

- Orchestrates 100+ specialized AI agents with swarm topologies (hierarchical, mesh, ring, star).
- Integrates natively with Claude Code MCP; simple setup via one-click install or NPX wizard.
- Supports automated workflows for coding, review, testing, security, architecture, and documentation.
- Features self-learning (vector memory), consensus algorithms (Raft/Byzantine/Gossip), and multi-LLM support (Claude/GPT/Gemini/Ollama).
- Includes built-in security protections and customizable plugin system.
